capabilities: Resize embedded images by dragging corner handles
Write the new size back into the wikilink embed
Snap image widths to the text column with a responsive 100% token
Set exact sizes via right-click menu and keyboard commands
extras: Only wikilink embeds (![[...]]) are supported, not markdown ![](url) or remote images; the responsive |100% token is a plugin-specific convention that may render as a caption in other plugins; on Obsidian 1.12+ the built-in corner-drag coexists with the plugin's handles.
problem: Resizing embedded images in Obsidian means typing size tokens like |300 by hand and eyeballing the result.

relations.evidence: Embedded Excalidraw drawings get the same handles

summary: Image resize tool that adds drag handles to embedded images and writes the resulting width or WxH size back into the wikilink.
